title: Surf at the end of Phase 1 — what works end to end
purpose: The elevator-pitch diagram. One page that shows everything Phase 1 can do today: a user uploads a factsheet PDF + lecture PDFs, the two pipelines run, the database fills up, and the data is ready for Phase 2 to build a UI on top of. The teacher should be able to use this single diagram to follow the data from 'user clicks Upload' to 'MCQs are stored and queryable'.
audience: non-engineer teammates and the grading teacher

groups.label: Factsheet pipeline (see factsheet_pipeline_v1 for the zoom-in)
Lecture pipeline (see lecture_ingestion_v1 for the zoom-in)

nodes.label: User (no UI in Phase 1 — pipelines are called from Python)
nodes.description: Phase 2 will add the My Classes page that triggers these pipelines

nodes.label: factsheet pipeline: clean + render
nodes.description: PDF → markdown → Claude (cleaner) → JSON → stored in classes.factsheet_json. Pure-Python renderer turns the JSON into student-facing markdown for display

nodes.label: lecture pipeline: ingest_lecture (5 stages)
nodes.description: PDF → markdown with PAGE markers → split into slides → LO extractor (Claude) → MCQ generator (Claude, batched) → DB writes. Honors retry, partial-success, and empty-mcqs policies

nodes.label: attempts + attempt_answers (empty in Phase 1 — schema only)
Phase 2: Mock-take page will read questions and write attempts
Phase 3: Dashboard will read attempts and slide_pages for progress views
Phase 2: Mock-review page will read attempt_answers + rationales

edges.description: Lecture pipeline reads the 7-key factsheet subset (D-1.2) to ground the LO extractor
Stored MCQs are picked up by the mock-take page

verification: Both Phase 1 pipelines (factsheet + lecture) are shown end to end
Both link out to their detailed specs (factsheet_pipeline_v1, lecture_ingestion_v1) via the group labels
Cross-pipeline dependency is shown: lecture pipeline reads classes.factsheet_json (the 7-key subset)
Phase 2 / Phase 3 consumers are shown but visually marked as future work — explains why attempts + attempt_answers tables are empty in Phase 1
All 8 tables appear (users implicit through classes.user_id)
